body:
The preact dependency isn't pinned, it's `^10.10.0`: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/aca8934163c047ca56db0dad679737f331efac29/packages/instantsearch.js/package.json#L39

The affected versions are 10.26.5 - 10.28.1, so that means we are actually not explicitly dependent on 10.28.0 as you mention.

The vulnerability would happen if a non-serialised object gets rendered, which would be possible with htm templates if you explicitly choose so.

It still seems interesting to bump the minimum to 10.28.2

Additionally, if you are using InstantSearch via React InstantSearch, this vulnerability can't be exposed to you, as no preact rendering happens in React InstantSearch.
